why_not_scored.explanation: Every frame has an empty edge list: the template was copied but not labelled. Mark the far edge of visible asphalt on each frame you want scored.
why_not_scored.note: This file measures nothing yet. The 22/25 from the earlier mask analysis still only means the model found no road there; it says nothing about what the camera could see.

scope: Development reach report: image rows available at a marked asphalt edge versus the mask and the planner. Not a distance, not a driving result.

scope_of_units.note: Rows are image-space reach at this angle. Metres additionally need camera height, pitch and field of view, verified independently.
scope_of_units.scope: Image-space asphalt edge, grid rows available at that edge, and planner reach. Not a distance, not a lane, not clearance

none_guessed: Frames without a mark are skipped, never filled with a prediction.
